newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight sees mix of destinations.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight sees mix of destinations.

text.p: The London sugar freight market was marked by a fair volume of activity on Wednesday.
Brokers said that Comet were rumoured to have fixed Arabian Express 17,000 dwt on timecharter for a trip delivery Caribbean to the Continent at close to $5,000 daily.
CSR were said to have fixed 20,000 bulk sugar Queensland Cigading for mid-May and Kerry were said to have fixed 13,000 bagged E Coast India to Indonesia for prompt loading.
Brokers also understood that Benham had fixed 7-10,000 bulk Georgetown, Guyana, US Gulf or Atlantic for first half May.
Among new orders, Cargill had 22,000 bulk sugar Puerta Quetzal to Black Sea, Baltic or Egyptian Med for 5-10 May and Andre had 7-10,000 Djibouti to E Africa for early May.
New business also included Kerry Trading with 14,000 bulk Thailand-China for mid-May.
